title: ogs_sbi_client_handler() failed [-1] (../lib/sbi/path.c:62)
body:

### Steps to reproduce

```
05/23 10:48:54.558: [sbi] WARNING: ogs_sbi_client_handler() failed [-1] (../lib/sbi/path.c:62)
```


This affects amfd, pcfd, udrd, bsfd, umdmd, ausfd, scpd, etc
